greeting: Hold it right there! No unauthorized personnel in the ring!
Official Blue on duty! Rules will be followed!
You here for the match? Good. We need audience. Sit anywhere but the first three rows. Blood zone.
State your business! Wrestling-related? Good. Other? Make it quick.
Back again? You must like the sport. Or the chaos. Both valid.
The rules exist for a REASON! Mostly insurance. But also SAFETY!
No weapons! No magic! No biting! Those are the BIG three!
Welcome to the Cinder Arena! Where I make sure NO ONE DIES! ...Usually.
dialog.rules_explanation: Standard Ember Rules: Three rounds, pinfall or submission only, no eye-gouging, no hitting below the belt, NO COMPLAINING about my calls!
dialog.officiating_philosophy: A good referee is invisible. Until they're not. Then they count VERY LOUDLY.
dialog.el_scorcho_opinion: The champion? Talented. Dramatic. Has never read the rulebook. I've tried to give him one. He uses it as a fan.
dialog.verde_opinion: The green kid? Got potential. Heart of gold. Technique of... tin. But he'll improve. Or break something. Probably both.
rumor: The old commissioner retired to Tide. Runs a fishing charter now. Weird guy.
There's an underground wrestling circuit in Obsidian. No rules. Sounds dangerous.
Word is Frost's league uses ice-themed moves. Illegal in our jurisdiction.
dialog.injury_record: Last month: three broken fingers, one dislocated shoulder, and a case of 'dramatic exhaustion.' It's a rough sport.
farewell: Stay behind the barrier! For your SAFETY!
Enjoy the match! But remember - I'M in charge!
If you see illegal moves, shout! I'll pretend to hear you!
Come back for the next bout! Same arena, same rules!
ambient_barks: Clean fight! I want a CLEAN FIGHT!
Time out! Someone find his tooth!
That's a warning! Next one's a penalty!
dialog.time_dawn: Pre-match inspections. Checking the ropes. Testing the mat.
dialog.time_noon: No matches scheduled. Arena maintenance. Boring but necessary.
dialog.time_dusk: MATCH TIME! Crowd's building! Adrenaline flowing!
dialog.time_night: Post-match paperwork. So much paperwork. Injuries to report.

party_reactions.kade: You have the hardest job here. Keeping them safe from themselves.
party_reactions.nix7: Rule enforcement requires impartiality. Your neural patterns suggest 94% fairness.
party_reactions.twist: Can YOU wrestle too?! Referees look strong!
party_reactions.korr: Discipline matters. In combat and in sport.
party_reactions.renna: Do you know any healing spells? Seems useful in your line of work.
party_reactions.suresh: Fairness is a virtue. Even in entertainment.
party_reactions.sova: I'd make a terrible referee. Too tempted to join in.
party_reactions.grit: Respect. The rules keep people alive.
party_reactions.ashka: Rules? In a FIGHT? Hmph. But I understand order.
party_reactions.callum: Have you ever been accidentally hit? Looks dangerous!

relationship_dialog.stranger: New face. Stay behind the barrier.
relationship_dialog.acquaintance: You're becoming a regular. Good. We need consistent audiences.
relationship_dialog.friend: My favorite spectator! You know when to cheer!
relationship_dialog.best_friend: Between us? El Scorcho has a tell before his finisher. But don't tell him I told you.
